records.title: City of Copperas Cove Ordinance No. 2015-45
records.notes: Cited only for the recital confirming that Copperas Cove is a home rule municipality incorporated under Article XI, Section 5 of the Texas Constitution.

records.title: Thirteen city charter amendments to be put to Copperas Cove voters in November
records.notes: Source for the full Measure A through M list, charter review committee membership and meeting dates, the July 20 2021 public hearing, the August 3 2021 council order calling the election, and the statement that the charter was last amended in November 2018. News coverage is secondary evidence, not a primary record.

records.title: Early voting set to begin Monday
records.entity: Killeen Daily Herald and Copperas Cove Herald
records.notes: Carries verbatim ballot language for several 2021 measures including B, F, G and H.

records.title: Nov. 7 ballots set for Copperas Cove elections
records.entity: Killeen Daily Herald and Copperas Cove Herald
records.notes: Describes Propositions A and B on the 2023 ballot.

records.title: Cove incumbents retain seats in recent election
records.entity: Killeen Daily Herald and Copperas Cove Herald
records.notes: Four of five propositions passed. Compensation increase failed with 1,393 against (59.2 percent) and 960 for (40.8 percent). Also notes the similar 2021 proposal was rejected. Article states results were still to be canvassed.

records.title: Home Rule Charters
records.document_type: Attorney General Materials and Legal Reference
records.notes: Charter amendment requires approval by a majority of the qualified voters of the city who vote at an election held for that purpose, Tex. Loc. Gov't Code sec. 9.005(a). Notes an AG opinion that a home rule charter cannot provide for amendment by ordinance alone.

records.title: Texas City Charter Research
records.entity: Texas State Library and Archives Commission
records.notes: Explains that Texas cities were required to file certified copies of charters and amendments with the Secretary of State. This is the route to the original Copperas Cove charter.

records.title: Cove to canvass election votes
records.entity: Killeen Daily Herald and Copperas Cove Herald
records.notes: Confirms the City Council held a special meeting to canvass the November 2, 2021 election, including all ballot measures. This tells us the canvass document exists and roughly when it was created.

records.title: Copperas Cove Code of Ordinances, Part I Charter
records.entity: City of Copperas Cove via Municode
records.notes: The current charter is published here. Municode renders in the browser so the text cannot be retrieved by an automated fetch. Use the Download (Docx) control at the Charter or Article level. Node IDs confirm Article IV is Administrative Service and Sec. 4.05 is City Secretary.
